title: Keep the build-from-source route for developers?
recommendation: Yes: setup.sh and git-based Update now stay for people who change Tether; the download becomes the main way in, and Jordan's three Macs move to it
body: Options: keep both · download only (removes setup.sh, update.sh, deploy.sh and the per-Mac signing; simpler, but no way to run local changes as an installed app).

answer.text: Yes: setup.sh and git-based Update now stay for people who change Tether; the download becomes the main way in, and Jordan's three Macs move to it
